articles.title_en: Gatekeepers and the endogenous design of consumer preferences under personalized pricing
articles.title_cn: 守门人与个性化定价下消费者偏好的内生设计
articles.abstract_en: We develop a Hotelling duopoly model of competition on a gatekeeper platform in which firms choose between uniform pricing and personalized pricing. Implementing personalized pricing requires access to a platform-provided pricing technology and entails a per-transaction fee set by the platform. The platform also designs rankings and recommendations that affect the distribution of consumers between loyal and marginal types.We show that the platform may strategically reshape the demand environment to make personalized pricing more attractive to firms and thereby raise the fee it can charge. By reallocating mass from loyal to marginal and more disloyal consumers, the platform intensifies competition under uniform pricing and relaxes firms’ adoption constraint. Excessive centralization, however, erodes the rents that sustain fee extraction, so the platform chooses an interior degree of demand centralization. Relative to a no-manipulation benchmark, this reallocates surplus toward the gatekeeper and away from firms and consumers. When the platform also appropriates a share of seller profits, its incentives may reverse: it may favor loyalty-enhancing designs that soften downstream competition. The analysis highlights how platform monetization and recommendation design jointly determine downstream competition and its welfare consequences.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个守门人平台上的竞争性Hotelling双寡头模型，其中企业选择统一定价或个性化定价。实施个性化定价需要获得平台提供的定价技术，并支付由平台设定的每笔交易费用。平台还设计排名和推荐，影响消费者在忠诚型和边际型之间的分布。我们表明，平台可能策略性地重塑需求环境，使个性化定价对企业更具吸引力，从而提高其可收取的费用。通过将质量从忠诚型消费者重新分配给边际型和更不忠诚的消费者，平台加剧了统一定价下的竞争，并放松了企业的采用约束。然而，过度的集中化会侵蚀维持费用提取的租金，因此平台选择内生的需求集中度。相对于无操纵基准，这将剩余从企业和消费者重新分配给守门人。当平台还占有卖方利润的一部分时，其激励可能逆转：它可能倾向于增强忠诚度的设计，以软化下游竞争。该分析强调了平台货币化和推荐设计如何共同决定下游竞争及其福利后果。

articles.title_en: Contested transparency: Digital monitoring technologies and worker voice
articles.title_cn: 有争议的透明度：数字监控技术与劳动者话语权
articles.abstract_en: Advances in artificial intelligence and data analytics have notably expanded employers’ monitoring and surveillance capabilities. While new digital monitoring (DM) technologies facilitate the accurate observability of work effort, their productivity and broader welfare implications remain subject to debate. In this context, many countries confer information, consultation and co-determination rights to employee representation (ER) bodies on matters related to workplace organization and the introduction of new technologies, which could potentially discourage employers from making DM investments. Using a cross-sectional sample of more than 21,000 European establishments, we find instead that establishments with ER are more likely to utilize DM technologies than establishments without ER. We also document a positive effect of ER on DM utilization in the context of a local-randomization regression discontinuity analysis that exploits size-contingent policy rules governing the operation of ER bodies in Europe. We rationalize this unexpected finding through the lens of a theoretical model in which shared governance via ER creates organizational safeguards that mitigate workers’ control-averse responses to monitoring.
articles.abstract_cn: 人工智能和数据分析的进步显著扩展了雇主的监控与监视能力。虽然新的数字监控（DM）技术有助于对工作投入进行准确的可观测性，但其生产率和更广泛的福利影响仍存在争议。在此背景下，许多国家就工作场所组织和引入新技术相关事项，赋予员工代表（ER）机构信息、协商和共同决定权，这可能潜在地抑制雇主进行DM投资。使用超过21,000家欧洲机构的横截面样本，我们发现，拥有ER的机构比没有ER的机构更可能使用DM技术。我们还在一项局部随机化回归断点分析中记录了ER对DM利用的正向效应，该分析利用了欧洲 governing ER机构运作的规模 contingent 政策规则。我们通过一个理论模型的视角对这一意外发现进行合理化解释，在该模型中，通过ER实现的共同治理创造了组织保障，从而缓解了劳动者对监控的控制厌恶反应。

articles.title_en: Procompetitive effects of vertical mergers? Evidence from the European Union
articles.title_cn: 纵向合并的亲竞争效应？来自欧盟的证据
articles.abstract_en: This study examines the relationship between mergers and firm-level financial measures using a sample of 4482 acquisition targets in the European Union from 2007 to 2021. Findings suggest that horizontal mergers lack statistically significant results, whereas vertical mergers entail changes in markups (-0.7%), market share (+2.5%), Return on Fixed Assets (ROFA) (+2.3%), and capital intensity (-7.2%). The result for vertical mergers increases over time, and is larger when the number of pre-existing subsidiaries is greater. Our results suggest the elimination of double profit margins as a potential explanation.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究使用2007至2021年间欧盟4482个收购目标的样本，考察合并与企业层面财务指标之间的关系。研究发现，横向合并没有统计显著的结果，而纵向合并则带来加成率（-0.7%）、市场份额（+2.5%）、固定资产回报率（ROFA）（+2.3%）和资本密集度（-7.2%）的变化。纵向合并的结果随时间推移而增大，并且在原有子公司数量更多时更大。我们的结果表明，消除双重利润边际是一种可能的解释。

articles.title_en: Netflix and chilling effect? The impact of streaming video licenses on paid digital downloads
articles.title_cn: Netflix与 chilling effect？流媒体视频许可对付费数字下载的影响
articles.abstract_en: Digital distribution has expanded monetization opportunities for media firms, but it also introduces complex tradeoffs across channels. A central challenge for studios and networks is negotiating fixed-fee licensing deals with bundled subscription video-on-demand (SVOD) platforms like Netflix, whose flat-rate access model may cannibalize à la carte sales on transactional platforms such as iTunes.We exploit the natural experiment of Netflix’s launch in Australia to estimate the causal effect of licensing a film to the service on its digital sales. On average, licensing reduces à la carte downloads by 52.5%, with effects that persist even after titles are removed from Netflix – evidence that temporary bundling can have durable effects on competing transactional channels.Crucially, we show that this treatment effect is heterogeneous: the direction and magnitude of the effect vary systematically with a film’s à la carte price and its latent demand. Lower-priced titles exhibit positive treatment effects following Netflix inclusion while higher-priced titles experience substantial declines, consistent with a framework in which subscriber substitution and cross-segment exposure operate in opposite directions and are differently moderated by the à la carte price.Our findings offer rare revealed-preference evidence on how SVOD bundling interacts with underlying demand, addressing classic questions in industrial organization around bundling and channel conflict.
articles.abstract_cn: 数字分发为媒体公司拓展了变现机会，但也带来了跨渠道的复杂权衡。对制片厂和电视网而言，一个核心挑战是与Netflix等捆绑式订阅视频点播（SVOD）平台谈判固定费用许可协议，这类平台的统一费率访问模式可能会蚕食iTunes等交易型平台上的单点销售。我们利用Netflix在澳大利亚上线的自然实验，估计将一部电影许可给该服务对其数字销售的因果效应。平均而言，许可使单点下载减少52.5%，且即使影片从Netflix下架后效应仍然持续——这表明临时捆绑会对竞争性交易渠道产生持久影响。关键在于，我们表明这一处理效应具有异质性：效应的方向和幅度随影片的单点价格及其潜在需求而系统性变化。较低价格的影片在进入Netflix后表现出正向处理效应，而较高价格的影片则经历大幅下降，这与一个框架一致：订阅者替代和跨细分市场曝光朝相反方向作用，并受单点价格的不同调节。我们的发现提供了关于SVOD捆绑如何与潜在需求相互作用的罕见显示性偏好证据，回应了产业组织学中围绕捆绑和渠道冲突的经典问题。

articles.title_en: Impacts of privatization on state-owned enterprises: A tale of zombie versus healthy firms
articles.title_cn: 私有化对国有企业的影响：僵尸企业与健康企业的对比故事
articles.abstract_en: We estimate the effects of privatization on zombie versus healthy state-owned enterprises (SOEs) in China, extending our analysis beyond TFP to a broad array of financial and economic indicators. Privatizing zombie SOEs generates persistent favorable effects: it enhances labor productivity and TFP, reduces bank subsidies, lowers leverage and administrative expenses, improves liquidity, boosts profits, and accelerates sales growth, thereby increasing their probability of recovery. Privatization’s effect on reducing government subsidies, however, is generally weaker and appears to be transient. These benefits are more pronounced than for healthy SOEs and display some heterogeneity across regions and industries. Our findings offer policy implications for emerging markets, suggesting that prioritizing the privatization of underperforming, zombie-like entities can be associated with substantial economic gains and efficiency improvements.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们估计了私有化对中国僵尸企业与健康国有企业（SOEs）的影响，并将分析从TFP扩展到广泛的金融和经济指标。私有化僵尸国有企业会产生持续有利的影响：它提高劳动生产率和TFP，减少银行补贴，降低杠杆率和行政费用，改善流动性，提升利润，并加速销售增长，从而提高其复苏概率。然而，私有化在减少政府补贴方面的效果总体上较弱，且似乎是暂时的。这些益处比健康国有企业更为明显，并在地区和行业间表现出一定的异质性。我们的发现为新兴市场提供了政策启示，表明优先推进表现不佳、类似僵尸的实体的私有化，可能与显著的经济收益和效率提升相关联。

articles.title_en: The strategic value of platform encroachment: Seller entry and network effects
articles.title_cn: 平台侵占的战略价值：卖家进入与网络效应
articles.abstract_en: In a platform market where user participation is endogenous and shaped by direct network effects, we compare the competitive and welfare effects of two alternative business models: pure intermediation and ‘encroachment’ — a hybrid model where the platform competes with third-party sellers by selling its own private-label products. There are two groups of sellers: entrants, who must pay a specialization cost to access the marketplace, and incumbents, who have already paid it. With encroachment, the platform has no incentive to entirely foreclose their downstream rivals if there are positive network effects. Surprisingly, although encroachment restricts entry, it increases consumer surplus, total welfare, and the incumbents’ profit when there is a sufficiently large number of incumbents in the marketplace.
articles.abstract_cn: 在一个用户参与是内生的且受直接网络效应影响的平台市场中，我们比较了两种替代商业模式——纯中介与“侵占”（一种平台通过销售自有品牌产品与第三方卖家竞争的混合模式）——的竞争效应和福利效应。卖家分为两组：进入者，必须支付专业化成本才能进入市场；以及现有卖家，他们已经支付了该成本。在侵占模式下，如果存在正网络效应，平台没有激励完全排斥其下游竞争对手。令人惊讶的是，尽管侵占限制了进入，但当市场中的现有卖家数量足够大时，它会增加消费者剩余、总福利以及现有卖家的利润。

articles.title_en: Product variety, alcohol purchases, and the role of excise taxes
articles.title_cn: 产品种类、酒精购买与消费税的作用
articles.abstract_en: This study explores how product variety affects alcohol purchasing in the U.S., using store-level and household scanner data. By analyzing households that relocate to areas with different product availability and controlling for destination-specific consumption patterns, I document a positive relationship between increased product variety and higher alcohol purchases. I complement the household-level evidence with an analysis of two state-specific policy changes, the 2012 Washington liquor deregulation and the 2009 Illinois excise tax increase, to document that policies that raise prices, particularly the Washington liquor deregulation, are also associated with expanded product variety, which may partially offset the intended reduction in consumption. The results have important implications for public health: policymakers should be aware that alcohol market reforms can inadvertently increase product assortment and thereby stimulate consumption, particularly among the heaviest purchasers.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究利用门店层面和家庭层面的扫描数据，探讨产品种类如何影响美国的酒精购买。通过分析搬迁至产品可得性不同地区的家庭，并控制目的地特定的消费模式，我记录了产品种类增加与酒精购买量上升之间的正向关系。我用对两项州特定政策变化的分析来补充家庭层面的证据，即2012华盛顿州酒类放松管制和2009伊利诺伊州消费税上调，以记录提高价格的政策，尤其是华盛顿州酒类放松管制，也与产品种类扩大相关，这可能部分抵消预期的消费减少。这些结果对公共卫生具有重要启示：政策制定者应意识到，酒精市场改革可能无意中增加产品种类，从而刺激消费，尤其是在购买量最大的群体中。

articles.title_en: Dynamic price competition and evolutionary behavior with search
articles.title_cn: 带有搜索的动态价格竞争与演化行为
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a model of dynamic pricing with boundedly rational consumer search. Consumers observe one price, can choose to engage in costly search to learn the other prices, and then purchase from the firm with the lowest observed price. Each consumer searches only if the observed price exceeds their dynamically tuned reservation price. Firms optimize given the current distribution of reservation prices. Short run pricing is characterized by Edgeworth cycles. Rather than resetting as a mixed strategy, each cycle resets when the firm with the larger installed base relents by monopolizing its residual demand. Both the lower and upper bounds of the cycles move with consumer search, though not necessarily in the same direction. Whether these cycles persist in the long run or the pricing dynamic converges to the Diamond paradox, the Bertrand paradox, or a kinked-demand equilibrium depends on exogenous conditions that we outline.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个具有有限理性消费者搜索的动态定价模型。消费者观察到一个价格，可以选择进行有成本的搜索以获知其他价格，然后从观察到的最低价格的企业处购买。每个消费者仅当观察到的价格超过其动态调整的保留价格时才进行搜索。企业在给定当前保留价格分布的情况下进行优化。短期定价以Edgeworth周期为特征。每个周期并非作为混合策略重置，而是当拥有较大安装基础的企业通过垄断其剩余需求而让步时重置。周期的下界和上界均随消费者搜索而移动，尽管不一定同向移动。这些周期在长期内是持续存在，还是定价动态收敛于Diamond悖论、Bertrand悖论或弯折需求均衡，取决于我们所概述的外生条件。

articles.title_en: Evaluating substitutes for federal antitrust: The case of COPAs
articles.title_cn: 评估联邦反垄断的替代方案：以COPAs为例
articles.abstract_en: Are state-imposed behavioral remedies effective substitutes for federal antitrust enforcement? We evaluate state regulation of hospital mergers under Certificates of Public Advantage (COPAs). Using hospital data from 1996–2022, we estimate the treatment effect of mergers for both COPA-regulated events and unregulated but similar anticompetitive events, each relative to non-merging controls. The difference between the two treatment effects isolates the impact of state-imposed behavioral remedies: in highly concentrated markets, COPA mergers result in an 11.1 p.p. lower price effect but a 0.5 p.p. greater 30-day mortality effect. We find a negative correlation between price and mortality effects for COPA mergers, consistent with theoretical predictions that binding price caps exacerbate quality deterioration. Our findings suggest that COPA contracts are poor substitutes for traditional antitrust enforcement.
articles.abstract_cn: 州级实施的行为救济能否有效替代联邦反垄断执法？我们评估了在公共优势证书（COPAs）下州政府对医院合并的监管。利用来自1996-2022的医院数据，我们估计了COPA监管事件和未受监管但类似的 anticompetitive 事件的合并处理效应，各自相对于未合并的对照组。两种处理效应之间的差异分离出州级实施的行为救济的影响：在高度集中的市场中，COPA合并导致价格效应低11.1个百分点，但30天死亡率效应高0.5个百分点。我们发现COPA合并的价格效应与死亡率效应之间存在负相关，这与理论预测一致，即具有约束力的价格上限加剧质量恶化。我们的发现表明，COPA合同是传统反垄断执法的糟糕替代品。

articles.title_en: An experimental study on the effect of knowledge on idea generation and idea selection
articles.title_cn: 知识对想法生成与想法选择影响的实验研究
articles.abstract_en: How firms generate and select ideas influences their strategic path and the development of entire industries. To better understand this process, we experimentally analyze the impact of knowledge on idea generation and selection in an incentivized ideation task. Between treatments, we vary whether or not ideators are provided with examples of previous successful ideas before working on the task. We provide causal evidence that knowledge about such example ideas leads to path dependencies, i.e., knowledge increases the similarity of new ideas to those provided. Consistent with the hypothesis that knowledge affects the search for new ideas, we find evidence of path dependencies during idea generation, but do not find statistically significant evidence of additional path dependencies during idea selection. Overall, when knowledge is provided, we observe an increase in selected innovative ideas that are similar to previous ideas and a decrease in selected innovative ideas that are different from previous ideas.
articles.abstract_cn: 企业如何生成和选择想法会影响其战略路径以及整个产业的发展。为了更好地理解这一过程，我们在一个有激励的想法生成任务中实验分析知识对想法生成和选择的影响。在不同处理之间，我们改变是否在开展任务前向想法生成者提供以往成功想法的示例。我们提供因果证据表明，关于此类示例想法的知识会导致路径依赖，即知识会增加新想法与所提供想法之间的相似性。与知识影响新想法搜索的假设一致，我们在想法生成过程中发现了路径依赖的证据，但未在想法选择过程中发现额外路径依赖的统计显著证据。总体而言，当提供知识时，我们观察到与以往想法相似的被选创新想法增加，而与以往想法不同的被选创新想法减少。

articles.title_en: Convergence to collusion in algorithmic pricing
articles.title_cn: 算法定价中向合谋的收敛
articles.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence algorithms are increasingly used by firms to set prices. Previous research shows that they can learn to collude, but how quickly and reliably they can do so has remained an open question. I study average-reward soft actor-critic algorithms that set continuous prices in the workhorse environment of this literature: a repeated Bertrand duopoly with symmetric firms, deterministic logit demand, and constant marginal costs, where agents observe only market prices and their own profits. The algorithms can converge to a collusive outcome within 50,000 periods, and in 36% of simulations learned punishments make one-period deviations unprofitable, so that high prices are mutual best responses. Successful simulations show cooperative behaviour supported by reward-punishment schemes that discourage deviations. When high prices are not supported by punishments, profitable deviations are typically on the order of hundredths of a percent.
articles.abstract_cn: 企业越来越多地使用人工智能算法来设定价格。已有研究表明，算法可以学会合谋，但其能以多快、多可靠的速度实现合谋仍是一个未决问题。我研究了平均奖励软演员-评论家算法，该算法在本文献的经典环境中设定连续价格：一个对称企业的重复伯特兰双寡头，确定性logit需求，以及常数边际成本，其中智能体仅观察市场价格和自身利润。算法可以在50,000期内收敛到合谋结果，并且在36%的模拟中，学到的惩罚使单期偏离无利可图，从而高价成为相互最佳反应。成功的模拟显示出由奖励-惩罚机制支持的合作行为，该机制抑制偏离。当高价未得到惩罚支持时，有利可图的偏离通常约为百分之几的百分之一量级。

articles.title_en: Dynamics and determinants of exporter survival: A machine learning approach
articles.title_cn: 出口商生存的动态与决定因素：一种机器学习方法
articles.abstract_en: Exporting is precarious. In Australia, one-third of exporters in a given year are entrants; however, around 60 percent of these entrants exit within their first year. These firms start small, but those that survive expand rapidly and drive the country’s total trade in the subsequent years. One explanation in the literature is that exporters are hit with an ex-post shock upon entry; hence, some survive, and others do not. The paper finds that the answer is more nuanced. Using Australian administrative data, the study: i) applies conventional econometric and machine learning techniques, along with Shapley values, to predict and understand exporter survival; ii) provides a systematic comparison of the predictive performance of ML and conventional approaches. The study documents two key findings. First, exporter survival is shaped by firms’ ex-ante heterogeneity, such as export portfolio, size, and prior export experience, as well as strategic complementarities through compatriot-firm networks. Second, ML models outperform conventional approaches in out-of-sample prediction and deliver more balanced reductions in misclassification errors and their associated costs. The results shed light on the determinants of exporter survival and highlight the value of ML for solving prediction problems such as targeting of export promotion activities, which tend to be distributed ad hoc.
articles.abstract_cn: 出口具有不稳定性。在澳大利亚，某一年中三分之一的出口商是新进入者；然而，这些新进入者中约有60%在进入的第一年内退出。这些企业起步规模较小，但存活下来的企业迅速扩张，并在随后几年推动了该国的总贸易。文献中的一种解释是，出口商在进入时受到事后冲击；因此，一些企业存活下来，另一些则没有。本文发现答案更为微妙。该研究使用澳大利亚行政数据：i）应用传统计量经济学和机器学习技术，并结合Shapley值来预测和理解出口商生存；ii）对机器学习方法和传统方法的预测性能进行系统比较。该研究记录了以下两个关键发现。第一，出口商生存受企业事前异质性（如出口组合、规模和先前出口经验）以及通过同胞企业网络形成的战略互补性的影响。第二，机器学习模型在样本外预测中优于传统方法，并在误分类误差及其相关成本方面带来更平衡的减少。这些结果揭示了出口商生存的决定因素，并凸显了机器学习在解决诸如出口促进活动 targeting 等预测问题上的价值，而这些活动往往以临时方式分配。

articles.title_en: Order of entry and market performance in the global smartphone industry
articles.title_cn: 全球智能手机行业的进入顺序与市场绩效
articles.abstract_en: The global cell phone market has transitioned significantly from feature phones to smartphones since 2007. This particular period of smartphone industry expansion, and a detailed product-level dataset of all the cell phones sold in 40 major economies between 2007 and 2016, give us an unprecedented chance to study how the order of entry affects the performance of the same firm in different markets. We begin with a theoretical framework wherein the order of a firm’s entry affects both consumers’ preferences and suppliers’ delivery costs. We then document a market sales advantage for early entrants, especially those originating from developed countries, offering higher-priced products, or having diversified product lines. Finally, we show that adopting product-specific innovations, such as the Android operating system and high-performance hardware components, can help late followers leapfrog over formerly leading firms.
articles.abstract_cn: 自2007以来，全球手机市场已从功能手机显著转向智能手机。智能手机行业这一特定扩张时期，以及40个主要经济体在2007至2016年间售出的所有手机的产品层面详细数据集，为我们研究进入顺序如何影响同一企业在不同市场的绩效提供了前所未有的机会。我们首先建立一个理论框架，其中企业进入顺序同时影响消费者偏好和供应商交付成本。随后，我们记录了早期进入者的市场销售优势，尤其是那些来自发达国家、提供更高价格产品或拥有多元化产品线的企业。最后，我们表明，采用产品特定创新，如Android操作系统和高性能硬件组件，可以帮助后期跟随者超越原先领先的企业。

articles.title_en: Channel coordination on exclusive vs. non-exclusive content under endogenous consumer homing
articles.title_cn: 内生消费者归属下的独家与非独家内容渠道协调
articles.abstract_en: We analyze competition between two digital platforms selling subscriptions for unlimited access to their content catalogs. An upstream content provider offers additional content and chooses between a per-consumer wholesale price and a non-marginal contract, modeled as revenue sharing. The platforms independently decide whether to buy this additional content, so that exclusive or non-exclusive distribution arises endogenously. With low initial exclusivity, the content provider and both platforms prefer per-consumer wholesale pricing, yielding non-exclusive distribution and full consumer singlehoming. With high initial exclusivity, all parties prefer a non-marginal contract, yielding exclusive distribution and partial multihoming. Allowing contracts contingent on exclusivity does not change these predictions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析两个数字平台之间的竞争，这两个平台销售订阅服务，允许无限制访问其内容目录。一个上游内容提供商提供额外内容，并在按消费者批发价格和非边际合同（建模为收入分成）之间进行选择。平台独立决定是否购买该额外内容，因此独家或非独家分销内生出现。在初始独家性较低时，内容提供商和两个平台都偏好按消费者批发定价，产生非独家分销和完全消费者单归属。在初始独家性较高时，所有各方都偏好非边际合同，产生独家分销和部分多归属。允许合同以独家性为条件不会改变这些预测。

articles.title_en: Assessing the common ownership hypothesis in the US banking industry
articles.title_cn: 评估美国银行业中的共同所有权假说
articles.abstract_en: We assess the common ownership hypothesis (COH) in the US banking industry; our preferred estimates do not support it. Public banks offer similar deposit rates in markets where they have common shareholders with rivals and in markets where they do not. Our preferred panel regressions of deposit rates on profit weights implied by the COH yield precise zeros. Estimated effects on deposit quantities also do not support the COH.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在美国银行业评估共同所有权假说（COH）；我们的首选估计不支持该假说。上市银行在与竞争对手拥有共同股东的市场和没有共同股东的市场提供相似的存款利率。我们将存款利率对COH所隐含的利润权重进行的首选面板回归得到精确的零值。对存款数量的估计效应也不支持COH。
